Borregaard ASA develops, produces, and markets biomaterials, biochemicals, and biofuels in Norway, rest of Europe, Asia, America, and internationally. The company has market cap of $. It operates through three divisions: Performance Chemicals, Specialty Cellulose, and Other Businesses. It currently has negative earnings. The Performance Chemicals segment provides lignin binding and dispersing agents for use in a range of end market applications, such as construction, industrial binders, agrochemicals, and batteries, as well as trades in chemicals related to lignin products.
